subject: New Track Sponsor: Prior Labs
body:
Builders,

We’re excited to welcome [Prior Labs](https://www.linkedin.com/company/prior-labs/) as a Track Sponsor of the 2nd edition of the Berlin Robotics & AI Hackathon!

Prior Labs are the creators of TabPFN, the foundation model for tabular data that delivers instant, calibrated predictions on any table, no training required.

Prior Labs will have their own track at the hackathon: TabPFN for spatial awareness. We’ll share all the details soon, so stay tuned.

A big thank you to the Prior Labs team for backing the community.

A quick reminder: spots are extremely limited, and a Luma ticket alone is not enough. Fill out the mandatory form to enter the selection process: [https://tally.so/r/vXGxx8](https://tally.so/r/vXGxx8)

Register now: [https://luma.com/h0mcaqio](https://luma.com/h0mcaqio)

See you in Berlin!
